thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased 5xx error rate observed for service=redwood-inference-gateway in prod. p95 latency elevated. Current cluster 5xx ~11% over 2m. Auto-paged: @mike.w, @jess

mike.w: I see the PD. spinning up 2 more gateway replicas and draining suspect nodes (OOMs flagged). starting tail of gateway logs now.

jess: adding context 1m ago upstream provider 'ProviderX' reported partial outage. but we also have 502/504s originating inside our async handler stack. not purely external.

andre: logs show a lot of "connection reset by peer" between proxy -> model-backend. also some TLS handshake failures. could be connection churn or backend overload.

mike.w: good catch. can we route traffic to fallback model-route for non-critical traffic? I don't want to impact Dedicated customers.

jess: I'll create a canary route: 15% traffic -> model-variant:openai-compat-fallback (non-Dedicated routes only). applying now.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-12345 created. Severity: P1. Related alerts: INFR-GW-5XX, BACKEND-CONN-RESET. Link: https://pd.example/INC-12345

support-bot: Notifying support teams. Customer-impact note: Hosted API (us-west) showing increased errors. Dedicated clusters appear stable so far.

andre: running quick aggregate to split errors by upstream:
```
# splunk-ish pseudo
index=prod logs | where service=="inference-gateway" and status>=500 | stats count by upstream_provider, route
```
Results: ProviderX: 62% (chat), model-backend: 30% (generation), proxy: 8% (misc)

mike.w: reroute applied. 5xx dropped to ~5% within 3m but p95 latency still high (2.1s).

jess: proposal for alert tuning so we don't get noisy pages for short upstream blips:
- cluster-wide 5xx alert: threshold -> 4% over 5m (was 2% over 2m)
- add annotation on alert to trigger automated routing fallback when fired
- new internal alert: model-backend 5xx > 1% over 5m -> pages infra team

andre: +1. also request a dashboard with these panels: 1) 5xx by upstream_provider (timeseries), 2) 5xx by route (stacked), 3) connection reset count by backend host. helps quicker triage.

elaine: I'll file INFRA-478 to track: alert rule changes, dashboard creation, runbook update, and a retro. assigning to Observability.

mike.w: handoff note for @jess at 10:25: what I changed: scaled gateway +2, drained two OOMing nodes, applied canary reroute 15% -> fallback, grepped logs for CONN_RESET. PD link + runbook below.

jess: taking over. will monitor 5xx and telemetry for the next 45m. I'll also coordinate with SRE to validate TLS handshake metrics.

andre: quick grep commands used for triage:
```
# top 20 backends by 5xx
index=prod logs | where status>=500 | stats count by backend_host | sort -count | head 20
# connection reset sample
index=prod logs "connection reset by peer" | head 200
```

jess: adding proposed alert rule snippet (Prometheus-like pseudocode):
```
# cluster-wide 5xx (non-dedicated)
alert: Cluster5xxTooHigh
expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\",dedicated=\"false\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\",dedicated=\"false\"}[5m])) > 0.04
for: 5m
annotations:
  runbook: https://docs.redwood/ops/runbooks/gateway-5xx
  automated_action: reroute-to-fallback
```

jess: and secondary internal alert: model-backend 5xx >1% -> page infra.

support-bot: Support draft message: "We're seeing increased errors for Hosted API customers in us-west due to upstream provider instability. We're actively mitigating and routing traffic to fallback models. No action required from customers; updates in PD incident."

elaine: created INFRA-478: https://issues.redwood/INFRA-478. Observability assignee: @nate.obs. ETA for dashboard + alert changes: EOD today.

mike.w: note for postmortem: check connection pool sizes, TLS renegotiation logs, and keepalive settings between proxy and model-backend. may need to raise ephemeral port range or adjust keepalive.

jess: agreed. added to retro items in INFRA-478. I'll run a loadtest against model-backend in staging with shorter keepalive to reproduce.

oncall-bot: Handoff reminder: @jess will be primary for the next shift starting 10:25. Please include incident link and runbook in the handoff.

jess: posting status update to incident and will update the runbook after we finalize alert thresholds. current status: mitigation stable, cluster 5xx ~3.8%, monitoring. will escalate if >4.5% or if internal model-backend 5xx >1%

mike.w: thanks all. follow-ups: INFRA-478, dashboard panels, alert rule PR, runbook edits, postmortem in 48h.

jess: action items summarized: [1] Change cluster-wide 5xx -> 4% @5m + auto-reroute annotation; [2] New page rule for model-backend 5xx >1% @5m; [3] Grafana panels split by upstream and route; [4] Runbook update with reroute steps and grep snippets; [5] Postmortem and connection-pool investigation.

support-bot: Logging customer-impact update to support ticketing: "Monitoring; mitigations applied; will follow-up with postmortem."

elaine: closing notes: please link any PRs to INFRA-478. tagging Observability channel for visibility.

jess: will post final incident summary in #incidents when PD is closed.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-12345 remains open. Last recorded mitigation: traffic canary -> fallback applied.
